title: MPS Limited (NSE: MPSLTD) — Institutional Business Monograph & Multi-Horizon Investment Dossier
sector: Scholarly, Education & Corporate-Learning Content Engineering and Platforms
holding_rationale: Zerodha holds 0 shares of MPSLTD, so there is nothing to hold, trim or exit. The business passes our audit, but at the ₹2,297.00 verified close the probability-weighted 12-month value is ₹2,440 (+6.2%) on current earnings and ₹2,254 (-1.9%) on year-end earnings, and reward-to-risk to the ₹2,005 invalidation level is 0.39:1 or worse. The tape sits at the Stage 3/Stage 4 boundary. Only the ₹2,070 end of the support zone clears 1.5:1 on both earnings bases (5.23:1 and 2.63:1).

holding_alerts.trigger: Conditional recommendation alert: price trades into the top of the support zone (₹2,150.00) AND the re-derived base value on year-end earnings is at least ₹2,367.50 (FY27E EBITDA of roughly ₹331 Cr or more)
holding_alerts.instruction: No shares are held, so nothing is sold. If both conditions hold, treat a limit order for one-third of the starter (about 1.08% of net worth, ₹46,493, 21 shares) as a recommendation. Reward-to-risk here is 1.79:1 on current earnings and only 0.63:1 on year-end earnings, so otherwise skip this level and keep the cash. Use limit orders: the stock trades roughly 15,000 to 19,000 shares a day.

holding_alerts.trigger: Recommendation alert: price trades into the lower support zone (₹2,070.00, the rising 200-day average); core order of about 2.17% of net worth (two-thirds of the starter)
holding_alerts.instruction: Two-thirds of the starter (about 2.17% of net worth, ₹92,986, 44 shares) is the core order, only if the business-quality gates in Chapter 9 still pass on the day. Reward-to-risk here is 5.23:1 on current earnings and 2.63:1 on year-end earnings. If the ₹2,150 level also fills, the first fill totals about 3.25% of net worth, half of the 6.5% TIER_2 cap. Nothing is sold.

A daily close below ₹2,005.00 cancels the watch (200-day average lost, Stage 4 confirmed). Keep the cash and re-underwrite only after a new base forms. If any shares were bought in the zone, this is the stop.

holding_alerts.trigger: Re-underwrite alert: weekly close above the falling 50-day average (about ₹2,500) on rising volume with the 30-week average rising
holding_alerts.instruction: This is not an order to buy or add. It re-opens the file: the base value is re-derived from the latest results (today's ₹2,410 base is below ₹2,500), the stop is re-based, and any add must clear 1.5:1 from its own price to the new stop.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: The next marginal unit of Zerodha INR cash (₹5,74,582 or 13.4% of net worth ₹42,91,664) and the 0% allocation to MPSLTD at the current price

destinations.entry_condition: Keep the reviewed capital in cash and earmark about 2.17% of net worth for a limit order at ₹2,070 (plus a conditional 1.08% at ₹2,150 if the re-derived base value is at least ₹2,367.50), cancelling on a daily close below ₹2,005
destinations.rationale: At ₹2,297 the expected return is between -1.9% and +6.2% and reward-to-risk is 0.39:1 or worse. Waiting for ₹2,070 lifts it to 2.63:1 to 5.23:1 without paying for the business twice.

destinations.entry_condition: AJMERA is already a 4.06% holding with its own IMMEDIATE_BUY dossier; any addition is a portfolio-audit sizing decision, not funded from this review
destinations.rationale: Its shortlist asymmetry (4.4:1 to a ₹195 target) is better than MPSLTD at the current price, but the position is already held and this dossier does not re-underwrite it.

destinations.entry_condition: Peers DATAMATICS, NIITMTS and NEWGEN are Stage 4 with a technical timing gate of CAP_REJECTED; revisit only after each builds a Stage 1 base
destinations.rationale: The three listed peers fell 18% to 56% over twelve months in the snapshot, earn 20% to 25% ROCE against MPS's 38.7%, and none passes the timing gate.

primer: MPS Limited turns manuscripts, textbooks and corporate training into finished digital products for the world's largest publishers. Its Research segment earns a 48% EBITDA margin, ten-year operating cash flow roughly equals profit, and the company carries no bank debt. Against that, the largest customer is 17.3% of revenue, goodwill and intangibles are 52.5% of assets, and generative AI is deflating the price of content production. At the ₹2,297.00 close of 12 November 2026 the expected 12-month return is between -1.9% and +6.2%, depending on the earnings basis. The verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, with a ₹2,070 to ₹2,150 watch zone (only ₹2,070 clears 1.5:1 on both bases), a ₹2,005 invalidation level and 0% allocation today.
gate_exceptions: Session date. The 13 November 2026 Nifty 50 bar was absent from the price source after two attempts (ledger build and a later retry), so the report is dated to the last verified session, 12 November 2026. MPSLTD closed at ₹2,297.00 in the ledger that day.

The TradingView and stage snapshot was pulled after the 13 November NSE close and carries that day's print of ₹2,259.30 (-1.64%). It is not benchmark-verified, so prices and verdict levels use the ledger close and the 13 November print is cited as later. The ledger labels the stock Stage 3, while the snapshot classifier labels it Stage 4 because ₹2,259.30 is 0.12% under the 30-week average of ₹2,262.01. The stricter reading governs timing.

TheWrap Stage 2 dashboard was extracted in Chrome and MPSLTD is not on the Stage 2 list. The options tool's auto-text called the setup a call-spread window above the weekly shelf. The 13 November print is under the shelf and MPSLTD has no NSE options chain, so the desk replaced that sentence in a copy of the options snapshot. The raw tool output is unchanged.
Holdings records were not refreshed for this session. MPSLTD is not held, so no position action depends on them.

Source gaps and disclosed discrepancies: the Q4 FY26 earnings-call transcript was read from a machine-generated source and an exchange filing; no Q2 FY27 segment tables were read, so Q2 FY27 segment figures come from the earnings call and its slides; Screener and audited figures differ on debtor days, ROCE, EPS and other income and each chapter states the audited basis; the NCLT hearing of 4 November 2026 on the ADI BPO amalgamation had no reported outcome at the time of writing.

Citation as-of exceptions (older than 60 days, latest available filings): MPSLTD:fy26_consolidated_results and MPSLTD:fy26_eps_net_cash (FY26 audited annual report, 2026-03-31; cure with the FY27 annual report in mid-2027), MPSLTD:promoter_holding (31 March 2026 holding in the annual report; the September 2026 shareholding table shows the same 68.34%) and MPSLTD:outcome_based_recurring_mix (Q1 FY27 call, August 2026; cure with the Q3 FY27 call in February 2027).

Review status: BEST_EFFORT_AFTER_REVIEW_LIMIT. Two review rounds ran. The red team's second pass held the verdict. The independent reviewer's second pass asked for two changes: show the scenario values on both earnings bases, and remove process wording. Both were made after round 2 and were not re-reviewed, because the review cap is two rounds. The reviewer and red team ran on the default model rather than the configured red-team model, which was not available under that identifier.
weinstein_stage: Stage 3/Stage 4 boundary (ledger Stage 3 at ₹2,297.00; snapshot Stage 4 at the 13 Nov print ₹2,259.30)

ch4.stage_explanation: Ledger Stage 3 at the 12 Nov close of ₹2,297.00: above the 30-week average (₹2,262.01, by 1.5%) and the rising 200-day (₹2,069.06), below the falling 50-day (₹2,517.11). On the 13 Nov print (₹2,259.30) the snapshot classifier reads Stage 4 because price is 0.12% under the 30-week average.
ch4.gate_intro_prose: The question here is simple: is MPSLTD close enough to a rising support level to be bought without chasing? On the 12 November close it is not. Price sits 1.89 ATR under a falling 50-day average and about 11% above the 200-day. The support band and stop below show where that answer would change.
ch4.closing_prose: The tape agrees with the valuation work in one respect and disagrees in another. The price is not demanding, but the trend has not turned. We therefore wait for support at the rising 200-day average instead of buying at ₹2,297.00 or at the 13 November print of ₹2,259.30.
ch4.tech_table_takeaway: The ledger rows use the 12 November close of ₹2,297.00. The extension percentages come from the 13 November snapshot (₹2,259.30). Against the snapshot's 10-week EMA (₹2,416.11) and 50-day average (₹2,501.56), the 12 November close is 4.9% and 8.2% below. Read the table as a Stage 3 to Stage 4 boundary: above the 30-week average at the ledger close and 0.12% under it on the later print.
ch4.posture_explanation: The snapshot classifier reads Stage 4 and caps new capital at WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT or below, because ₹2,259.30 is 0.12% under the 30-week average.
ch4.support_zone_explanation: Snapshot support band: pivot S1 of ₹2,065.93 and the rising 200-day average. Our entry zone of ₹2,070 to ₹2,150 adds the ₹2,152.20 swing low.
ch4.stop_placement_explanation: Our stop is a daily close below ₹2,005, under the 200-day average less about half an ATR. The snapshot's own structural stop is ₹2,010.85.
